about_the_game:
Block Catching is a childhood game of catching that takes place in a building with multiple levels. In this game you will be playing with friends, and one of them will be chosen as a catcher.

In The Game

  • Play with a group of friends (Max. 4)

  • One of them will be chosen as the 'Catcher'

  • Run, Hide, Scream and take the elevator...do not get caught. Do everything to survive the game of Block Catching.

From The Creator

Hi, I'm Justus Yew, the game creator of Block Catching. Block Catching is inspired by a local Singapore childhood catching game that died out as time passed, and I want our players to be able to experience the fun and excitement that we once had during our younger days.

In my game, Block Catching, there will be unique horror elements implemented to make it more thrilling. Hopefully we will be able to showcase some of these 'elements' as soon as they are ready!

content_descriptors.notes: Block Catching contains some mature content that might not be appropriate for all ages.
